subject: Post-demo: token economics, budget range & trial extension request
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2027 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: token economics, budget range & trial extension request

Hi Emily — great to meet earlier today and thanks for walking us through the recommendation flow. Quick recap and two asks so we can size the pilot economics and get you extended credits asap:

1) Recap: Demo covered: recommendation API, SDK integrations, prefix caching for session reuse, and the admin dashboard for per-route cost breakdowns. You mentioned a 3-week dev sprint to wire a limited set of flows into dev and a staged rollout to 10% of traffic.

2) What we need from you this week (very helpful if you can confirm by EOD Thursday):
  - Estimated monthly active users for pilot (MAU) and expected requests per user session
  - Average tokens per request (or an example prompt + expected response length)
  - Target $/1M tokens you need to hit (we can then map to model choices + quantization/ batching to meet that threshold)
  - Budget range for the initial 30–60 day pilot (ballpark is fine)

3) Our side: I attached our current rate card (redwood_rate_card_q3.pdf). For short pilots we typically approve one-off credits and a 30-day trial extension while you validate steady-state throughput. If you can share projected token volumes, we’ll propose a credit amount and an expected unit-cost plan.

Next steps: once we have your numbers I’ll run them with Marissa and Sales Ops (Ben) to propose credits + the model/config that meets your target $/1M tokens. If you’re open, I can also set up a 30-minute econ call to walk the math.

Thanks —
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: redwood_rate_card_q3.pdf (PDF, 420KB)
From: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novaretail.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: token economics, budget range & trial extension request

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear recap. Below are the numbers from our side after a quick sync with product/infra: 

- Pilot target MAU: ~120,000 (we’ll roll to ~10% of our user base to start)
- Avg requests per active user during pilot: 2.5 sessions/day (some will be passive) -> ~300k requests/month
- Avg tokens per request: ~240 input + ~360 output = ~600 tokens/request (this is an average across the 3 core flows)
- Projected tokens/month: ~180M tokens/month (300k requests * 600 tokens) — we expect ramp from 40M -> 180M over 4 weeks
- Budget for initial 30–60 days: $4,000–$8,000 (leadership wants to keep spend modest while we validate latency/quality)
- Target unit economics: ideally <= $2,000 per 1M tokens once at steady state (this would be our internal hurdle for broader rollout)

We’d like to request a 30-day trial extension and an initial credit to cover the expected burn while we ramp. If you can suggest the amount you’d typically provide for a footprint of this size, that would be great. I attached our rough pilot usage estimate (novaretail_pilot_usage_estimate.csv).

Open to the econ call — Wed or Thu this week work for me.

Best,
Emily Chen
Head of Platform Integrations | NovaRetail
emily.chen@novaretail.com

Attachment: novaretail_pilot_usage_estimate.csv (CSV, 12KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 Sep 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Post-demo: token economics, budget range & trial extension request

Forwarding Emily’s ask — key points: 180M tokens projected at steady state, target <= $2k per 1M tokens, budget $4k–$8k for 30–60d, requests 300k/month. They asked for a 30-day extension + initial credit.

My recommendation: approve a one-time pilot credit up to $10,000 and a 30-day extension while Sales Ops validates unit-cost plan. If we provide $10k it will cover roughly 5M tokens at a $2k/1M rate — but we should size credits against our cost model (we can steer them to cheaper model variants / quantized variants).

Ben — please run the econ back-of-envelope and propose the exact credit + model mix. I’ll prepare a succinct M.A.P. and the trial T&Cs if Ops signs off.

-Marissa
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Credit approval request: NovaRetail pilot (RDW-4891)

Evelyn — requesting your approval for a one-time pilot credit + 30-day trial extension for NovaRetail (deal RDW-4891). Details below: 
  - Projected steady-state: up to 180M tokens/month (ramp 40M -> 180M over 4 weeks)
  - Customer target unit-econ: <= $2k per 1M tokens
  - Proposed Redwood support: 30-day trial extension + $10,000 pilot credit to be consumed against usage during the extension window
  - Attachments: rate_card, customer usage estimate, proposed trial terms (trial_extension_terms.pdf)

Rationale: This is a high-strategy retail customer with potential to convert to dedicated capacity. The credit will let them validate integration and steady-state economics; we’ll couple it with a recommended model/config that meets their $/1M target.

Please reply with Approve/Decline and any constraints (e.g., usage windows, caps, required success criteria).

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2027 11:26:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Credit approval request: NovaRetail pilot (RDW-4891)

Approve - one-time $10,000 credit and 30-day trial extension. Conditions:
  - Credit valid only for usage during the 30-day extension window (no retroactive application)
  - Cap: credit can be used for hosted API consumption only (not professional services)
  - If usage exceeds $10k before 30 days, notify Finance and Sales Ops for additional review
  - Require a 1:1 post-pilot eco review meeting to confirm unit economics and next steps

Please document these terms in the trial T&Cs and send the customer a brief summary.

Evelyn Hart
Head of Finance | Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Chen <emily.chen@novaretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Approved: 30-day extension + pilot credit details (NovaRetail / RDW-4891)

Hi Emily — good news: Finance has approved a one-time $10,000 pilot credit plus a 30-day trial extension. Summary and next steps below:

What we approved:
  - 30-day trial extension starting when you flip the pilot flag
  - $10,000 one-time credit, valid only for hosted API consumption during the 30-day window (per Finance terms)
  - We’ll recommend a model/config to target <= $2k per 1M tokens; that recommendation will include quantized variant and batching/PKV cache knobs to hit the unit economics

Immediate next steps:
  1) If you confirm a start date I’ll push the trial extension live and attach the credit to your account (we’ll provide an internal spend cap alert)
  2) I’ll schedule the 30-minute econ call to walk the math (Thu 10:00 AM PT / Thu 2:00 PM ET suggested) — let me know which works
  3) Please review the attached trial_extension_terms.pdf (short T&Cs) and reply to accept; we’ll also capture the MAP in the linked doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1a2b3c-pilot-m.a.p

If you want a quick preview of the recommended model mix before we start, Marissa will send a one-pager today.

Thanks — excited to get this running.

Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0132

Attachments: trial_extension_terms.pdf (PDF, 18KB)
